request.text: [HIRING] Video Editors – True Crime YouTube. We're building a team for a YouTube channel focused on long-form, single-case true crime documentaries (40+ minutes). profile.deadline: We aim to release one video per week, so the turnaround time for each video should be around 7 days.
profile.ai_policy: AI can be used for minor tasks like color correction and audio enhancement, but the core editing and storytelling should be done by the editor.

request.text: Looking for a Video Editor – Men's Fashion Content. I'm looking for a skilled video editor who can help edit content for social media. Ideally, you should be comfortable with video editing, color grading, pacing, transitions, and creating content that looks clean, polished, and engaging. Bonus points if you have previous experience editing content in the men's fashion / menswear niche. Pay is 5-10 usd depending on experience and skill.

profile.footage: I have raw footage of men's fashion outfits, runway shows, and some behind-the-scenes content. The footage is in 4K and I have about 1-2 hours of material.
profile.story: The video should highlight the latest trends in men's fashion, showcase different outfits, and include some behind-the-scenes moments to make it more engaging. I want to focus on the quality and style of the clothing, and maybe add some text overlays for key points.
profile.purpose: The video will be posted on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. It’s meant to attract followers and potential clients who are interested in men's fashion.
profile.duration: The final video should be around 1-3 minutes long, and I need both vertical and horizontal versions for different platforms.
profile.style: The style should be clean, polished, and modern. The pacing should be fast enough to keep the audience engaged but not too rushed. Smooth transitions and a professional color grade are important.
profile.music_text: I’d like to use upbeat, trendy music that fits the men's fashion vibe. Text overlays for key points and subtitles for any spoken parts would be great.
profile.cover: A dynamic cover image that captures the essence of the video, maybe a stylish outfit or a model in action. It should be eye-catching and representative of the content.
profile.deadline: I need the video within 1-2 weeks from when we start working together.
profile.budget: 5-10 USD per minute of edited video, depending on experience and skill.
profile.ai_policy: I’m open to using AI tools if they can help improve the quality and efficiency of the editing process.
profile.acceptance: The video needs to look professional and engaging. I’ll review it and provide feedback, and we can finalize it once I’m happy with the result.
